applies_to: Every tuned Stage 2 condition (B1, B2, B3; H1 uses the chosen B1 setting). Only B3 is defined here so far; the B1 and B2 grids will be added to this file, in a separate commit, before they run.
seeds: The seed is the model's noise seed in synthesis (and, for trained conditions, the training seed). Selection uses VALIDATION with seeds 0-2; the chosen setting is then tested once on TEST with seeds 0-7.
validation_data: The 20 validation sentences of data/stage2_sentences.json. Each output is compared with the fixed synthetic target of the same sentence (results/stage2/target/manifest.json).

metrics.primary: mel-cepstral distortion with DTW (mcd_db, lower is better)
secondary: F0 RMSE in cents on voiced aligned frames (f0_rmse_cents, lower is better)
duration ratio candidate/target (closer to 1 is better; measured as |ln ratio|)

choice: Per setting, average each metric over the 20 validation sentences x seeds 0-2. Keep the settings whose mean MCD is within 0.05 dB of the lowest mean MCD. Among them, keep those whose mean F0 RMSE is within 5 cents of the lowest. Among those, choose the smallest mean |ln duration ratio|. Remaining ties: the earlier setting in grid order.

B3.description: F2 with only the model's built-in inference controls; no weight edit.
B3.pitch_shift_units: The model's pitch_shift is added to natural-log F0; the grid value in semitones s is passed as s * ln(2) / 12.
